Anjali R: quick heads-up — running a longscope KV correctness run on magnet13b-int4v2 with 64k context. Observed a token shift around the 48k→50k boundary after a KV eviction during a shard swap. Repro steps and minimal logs below.

Sam K: can you paste a minimal repro?

Anjali R: repro command:
```
./tools/run_longscope.sh \
  --model magnet13b-int4v2 \
  --context 65536 \
  --batch 1 \
  --prompt tests/longscope/prompts/48k-evict.txt \
  --kv-window 512 \
  --quant int4
```
Output excerpt:
```
[2026-03-20T02:14:01Z] kv_index=129873 -> evict seq=129873
[2026-03-20T02:14:01Z] shard_swap: old_shard=3 new_shard=4
[2026-03-20T02:14:02Z] generation mismatch @tok=49984 expected='the' got='a'
```

Lee P: can you run with `--kv-debug=trace` and paste the last 10 kv entries? Might be a wrap/offset or stale index.

ml-ci-bot: CI job longscope-kv/482 failed — logs at https://ci.redwood.example/longscope/482 — artifacts saved (bench/logs/482).

Maria T: quick hypothesis — prefetch + async eviction race during shard swap; older shard indices leak into the new shard's read path leading to a one-token drift once the generation crosses the eviction boundary. Try disabling prefetch or bumping kv-window to 1024.

Anjali R: starting a run with `--kv-window=1024 --disable-prefetch` now. Tagging @infra-bot to check for node interrupts during the previous run.

infra-bot: gpu-pool-2: no preemptions recorded 02:00→03:00Z. dmesg snippet on gpu-07 shows one page-fault at 02:13:47 — uploading to bench artifacts.

Sam K: if repro is stable, please add a focused unit test in `tests/kv/repro_eviction_test.py` + a minimal bench under `bench/longscope/` so we have a deterministic job. I can take PR review.

Anjali R: will drop the reproducer script and trimmed logs in the bench bucket and open a triage issue (#TL-evict-122). Kicking off an overnight run. :eyes:
